title: JSON Library from Scratch
requirements: `Value` = `std::variant<std::nullptr_t, bool, double, std::string, Array, Object>` (recursive via `std::vector`/`std::map` or `unique_ptr`)
Recursive-descent parser with precise error positions (`std::expected<Value, ParseError>`)
Pretty and compact serializer; Unicode escapes (`é`)
Typed access with concepts; struct (de)serialization using your M11 serializer techniques
